title.orig: An Act to Amend Section One Hundred Seven of Commonwealth Act Numbered One Hundred Forty-One, Entitled “The Public Land Act”
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติที่ดินสาธารณะ

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1172_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section one hundred seven of Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred forty-one is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 107. All patents or certificates for land granted under this Act shall be prepared in the Bureau of Lands and shall be issued in the name of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines under the signature of the President of the Philippines: Provided, However , That the President of the Philippines may designate to the Undersecretary of Agricultural and Natural Resources the power to assign patents or certificates covering lands exceeding one hundred forty-four hectares in area. Such patents or certificates shall be effective only for the purposes defined in section one hundred and twenty-two of the Land Registration Act, and actual conveyance of the land shall be effected only as provided in said section."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1954.
